issue.title: @@notebook with a bullet-led item writes a '- [ ] #task - a' checkbox into the notebook
issue.description:
Found while consolidating the notebook section capture research
(research:202611/notebook_section_groups/notebook_section_groups__final.md, §3 bug 4).

## Reproduction (bob 0.5.0 built 2026-11-11 11:09 UTC, synthetic scratch vault)

Notebook `dev_tools.md` (`type: "[[notebook]]"`, parent `[[dev]]`). Real capture into a throwaway copy:

```text
@@dev_tools

- a
- b
```

writes into `dev_tools.md`:

```text
- [ ] #task - a [created::2026-11-11]
	- b
```

That is a checkbox task in a notebook. It breaks the notebook invariant in
`decisions:notebook-routes-write-notes` ("A notebook holds only note bullets and never a
checkbox"). Contrast:

- `@@dev_tools` / `A note` / `- detail` → a correct notebook note with detail.
- `@@dev_tools` / `* a` → a notebook note `- * a` (no checkbox, but the bullet marker leaks
  into the text).
- `@@dev` (an area) / `- a` / `- b` → `- [ ] #task - a` with the same leaked `- ` text.

## Probable root cause

`capture_language/notebook.rs::classify_item` skips the global notebook claim when
`item_has_explicit_operation(item)` is true. Its first-token check
`super::item::is_session_chain_token(first)` likely treats a bare leading `-` (a Pomodoro
session operator token) as a session chain. The bullet-led item therefore stays on the task
path. The `*` contrast above supports this: `*` is not a session operator, so the notebook
claims the item.

## Fix to decide

At minimum, a bullet-led item under a global notebook route must never reach the task
writer. Either:

- refuse it with teaching copy ("start the item with `@dev_tools` to file a list into a
  notebook"); or
- treat it as an implicit `@nb` list. That is a new `@@` meaning and needs a decision; see
  the research report's §6, "Do `@@nb` items support groups?".

Separately, consider whether `- a` as an item's first line should ever become task text
`- a` under `@@area`.

task_type_fields.impact: Any @@notebook draft whose item starts with '- ' silently writes a checkbox task into a notebook, breaking decisions:notebook-routes-write-notes; notebook checks and the no-task contract are violated without warning.
task_type_fields.repro:
bob capture -- $'@@dev_tools

- a
- b' against a vault where dev_tools.md is a notebook writes '- [ ] #task - a [created::…]' with child '- b' into dev_tools.md

issue.creation_reason: Found while verifying notebook capture behavior for the notebook-section research: a global notebook route lets a bullet-led item fall through to the task writer, violating the notebook no-checkbox invariant.
